source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the specific polemical description and promised reversal without extending it to a people as a whole.
key_decisions.before: Look, I will make those of the synagogue of Satan who say that they are Jews and are not, but lie—look, I will make them come and bow down before your feet, and they will learn that I have loved you.
key_decisions.after: Look, I will give you some from the synagogue of Satan, those who say they are Jews and are not, but lie. Look, I will make them come and bow before your feet and know that I have loved you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Behold, I will make those of the synagogue of Satan who say that they are Jews and are not, but lie—behold, I will make them come and bow down before your feet, and they will learn that I have loved you.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves keep/keep and the ambiguous from relation instead of selecting an end-times mechanism.
key_decisions.before: Because you have kept my word of endurance, I will keep you from the hour of trial that is coming on the entire world, to test the earth’s inhabitants.
key_decisions.after: Because you have kept my word of endurance, I too will keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come on the whole inhabited world, to test those who live on the earth.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Because you have kept my word of endurance, I will keep you from the hour of trial that is coming on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves beginning with its consequential range in the note rather than resolving it in the text.
key_decisions.before: “And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: The words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God’s creation.
key_decisions.after: “To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God's creation:
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: “And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: The words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God’s creation.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the visceral verb and the reversal of hot/cold order.
key_decisions.before: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I am about to spit you out of my mouth.
key_decisions.after: So because you are lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, I am about to vomit you out of my mouth.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I am about to spit you out of my mouth.
